name: Tahiti Nui Fortress (TNF) Data Center
notes: First data center of French Polynesia, operated by Tahiti Nui Telecom (Groupe OPT) at Papenoo PK 16.7 (datacentermap lists address Pk 16.7 c/mont, 98709 Mahina, Tahiti). Official tnfortress.pf datacenter page confirms colocation (shared rack from 20,000 F CFP/month, dedicated rack from 20U, private rooms), two EDT power feeds on two generators, about one week energy autonomy, colocation room hosting 1000+ 1U servers, APC racks with 2 power feeds, 24/7 access. Claims Tier3+ construction (official claim; no external certification document found). Service existence/address/status A-grade (official page); capacity not publicly disclosed.

name: TDF Data Center Papeete (Pic Rouge)
notes: TDF official release (2025-09-18) confirms opening of its 5th data center at Pic Rouge, on the heights of Papeete (300m altitude, outside flood zone): delivered June 2025 after H1 2025 works, repurposed former TV/radio/broadcast building, heat-recovery cooling, rooftop photovoltaics planned by end 2025, fibre + HD microwave connectivity, passed Tier III level compliance audit by a certified body (energy, cooling, fire detection/extinction, perimeter security). First customers on opening: Banque de Polynesie (Societe Generale subsidiary) and Axians Polynesie. Baxtel lists ~0.3 MW (C-grade directory figure, not used as official capacity).

name: TDF Pic Rouge Data Center extension (2026)
notes: TDF official release states an extension phase is already programmed for 2026 to widen site capacity and host new clients; recorded separately from existing operational capacity per methodology (extension planned = separate line).

name: Kyndryl Papeete data center
notes: Datacenters.com directory lists a Kyndryl Tahiti - French Poly data center in Papeete, French Polynesia; Kyndryl maintains a Papeete office (locations page). No primary technical facility details, capacity or independent verification found; directory-only evidence (C-grade), kept as a lead not as confirmed commercial colo.
